findings.failing_input: The header comment loudly warns 'this file MUST NEVER be imported by a client component'. There is no runtime guard enforcing this — a developer could accidentally import it from a 'use client' file and ship the service_role key to the browser bundle.
findings.expected: A `if (typeof window !== 'undefined') throw new Error('supabaseAdmin must not be imported client-side')` at module top would catch this at runtime.
findings.actual: Only a comment; no defensive throw.
findings.fix_sketch: Add the typeof-window guard at top of file; possibly an eslint custom rule that flags imports of supabaseAdmin from files with 'use client'.
findings.regression_test_idea: Import supabaseAdmin from a test file with a faked window object; assert throws.

uncertainty_notes: Tiny module — service_role Supabase client lazy factory. Correctly disables persistSession + autoRefreshToken + detectSessionInUrl per service_role best-practices. The throw-on-missing-env follows the same BL-01 pattern as supabase.ts so Inngest retries dead-letter correctly. The only concern is the lack of a runtime guard against accidental client-side import (STA-09), which the comment already flags as a planning defect class.
